# smudge

## Description

Smudging image slightly

## Arguments

- *(No additional program-specific arguments; uses global videobeaux options only.)*

## Program Template

```bash
videobeaux -P smudge -i input.mp4 -o output.mp4
```

## Real World Example

```bash
videobeaux -P smudge -i myvideo.mp4 -o smudge_styled.mp4
```
